pages.lesson:
LESSON: COUNTING

Grade: PP2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: NUMBERS
Topic 2.3: Counting

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Counting. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Counting
2. Solve practice questions on Counting
3. Use Counting in a real-life Kenyan example

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: COUNTING
Counting is a Grade mathematics skill used at school, at the market, and at home.

HOW TO STUDY THIS TOPIC
1. Read each idea slowly.
2. Copy every worked example into your book and recalculate it yourself.
3. Then try the practice questions without looking at the answers.

WORKED EXAMPLE STYLE
Write the question clearly. Show each step. Box the final answer.
Example framework:
  Question: (write a Counting problem)
  Step 1: …
  Step 2: …
  Answer: …

KENYAN CONTEXT
Use shillings, market goods, school desks, or garden plots as story numbers so the maths feels real.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Solve one simple Counting question using objects or a drawing.

Example 2: Solve a harder Counting question showing every step.

Example 3: Make a word problem about Counting set at a Kenyan market.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write and solve five questions on Counting.
2. Explain one solution aloud to a parent or friend.
3. Invent one new word problem and solve it.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Counting in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Show your working for every Counting question.
2. Check answers by estimating or by a second method.
3. Link every skill to a real-life example.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
